purpose: Build a reproducible Gaussian KAHM forecasting demonstrator with simultaneous fitted-risk upper certificates.

claim_scope.task: one-step scalar forecasting from a two-observation history
claim_scope.risk: population mean squared error under the specified history-successor law, conditional on development
claim_scope.loss_units: squared units of the declared observation values
unclaimed_properties: pointwise error or per-forecast interval coverage
performance under a changed evaluation law
optimal risk over a decoder class
global Lipschitz admissibility of the rounded decoder
exact input recovery or predictive sufficiency of the soft state
exact Koopman closure or recursive rollout accuracy
numerical equivalence to an ideal real-arithmetic Gaussian KAHM map
general superiority of KAHM or enrichment over the controls

benchmark.provenance: Based on our research; controlled finite benchmark defined in docs/BENCHMARK.md (finite_benchmark_v1).
benchmark.sampling: independent episodes sampled with replacement; exactly one (history,target) pair per episode

data_protocol.training_role: fit all preprocessing, reference geometry, decoder parameters and candidate models
data_protocol.validation_role: select among development candidates using validation MSE
data_protocol.calibration_role: evaluate the three already frozen fitted predictors and their risk upper endpoints
rng_requirements: record generator, implementation version, seed/stream scheme and role of every stream
use separate development and calibration streams
do not select or replace calibration randomness after inspecting outcomes
iid sampling is a statistical premise; different seed labels alone are not its proof

candidates.label: KAHM memberships plus local coordinates
candidates.features: same membership vector plus membership-weighted local PCA coordinates

representation_contract.gaussian_kahm_reconstruction: A_j(z) = Q_j^T C_j k_j(z) / (1^T C_j k_j(z)); C_j=(G_j+lambda_j I)^(-1)
representation_contract.score_family: radial/angular reconstruction score defined in docs/ENCODER_DESIGN.md (gaussian_kahm_encoder_v1)
representation_contract.bank_selection_rule: For each development bank, choose each KAHM variant's decoder by validation MSE; choose the shared bank minimizing the mean of those two best validation MSEs.
representation_contract.tie_rule: deterministic configuration ordering recorded before final selection
representation_contract.reference_selection_requirement: handle repeated input histories and respect distinctness/rank conditions; never discard calibration duplicates
representation_contract.soft_state_interpretation: the membership block is simplex-valued in the mathematical construction; the enriched vector also contains local coordinates
representation_contract.local_coordinate_formula: concatenate phi_j(z) P_j^T (z-mu_j) for all local models j

readout_contract.family: Gaussian Nystrom feature block appended to linear feature coordinates, ridge regression with intercept, and final clipping to [0,1]
readout_contract.reason: the controlled process has a nonlinear conditional mean; the same compact readout family is used for all candidates
readout_contract.decoder_scaling: fit feature transformations on training data and freeze them
readout_contract.hyperparameter_selection: validation MSE, with matched family, nominal budget and grid across candidates
readout_contract.landmark_identity_rule: use the same distinct raw-history landmark identities across candidates; encoded values and retained ranks may differ
readout_contract.fit_selection_policy: retain the training-fitted model chosen by validation

freeze_requirements: all three complete deterministic predictors, preprocessing, clipping and fallbacks
canonical inference behavior and runtime details
complete candidate/search configurations and development selection record
calibration episode count, RNG/stream choice, confidence allocation and tolerance
all 16 supported histories produce finite predictions in [0,1]
save/reload preserves the canonical predictions on the full input support
model-specific oracle risks are not used for final fitting or selection

certificate.empirical_risk: mean of all 4096 squared losses for the frozen candidate
certificate.endpoint: sup {p in [q,1] : kl(q||p) <= log(60)/4096}, where q is the exact empirical risk
certificate.conditional_guarantee: P_Cal[for every m, R_m(D) <= U_m | D] >= 19/20, under the declared premises
certificate.risk_definition: R_m(D)=E_P[(Y-f_m,D(X))^2], with a fresh draw independent of development D
numerical_requirements: interpret canonical finite floating-point predictions as their exact represented numbers
compute exact or verified upper empirical loss means
use a verified upper value of log(60)/4096
round the upper root and reported endpoint outward
compare against the exact rational tolerance 1/10
retain every calibration episode and predeclared fallback event

statuses.certificate_unavailable: a required premise or numerical check is not established

certificate.accepted_candidate_selection: any accepted candidate in the frozen three-member family may be selected while preserving this simultaneous guarantee
certificate.guarantee_scope: one final calibrated family; additional attempts require a suitable allocation or a separately reserved final evaluation

reference_audit.implementation: enumerate the 16 canonical predictions and use the 64 rational population weights
reference_audit.numerical_basis: dyadic targets and finite binary predictions permit exact rational risk calculation
reference_audit.use: independent audit after predictors have been selected and frozen
reference_audit.coverage_miss_rule: retain and investigate any realized R_m > U_m; a 95% theorem does not promise coverage on every run

change_control.prediction_rule_change_after_calibration: new model freeze and untouched calibration data; account for repeated-attempt selection
change_control.equivalent_code_or_conservative_recalcul: archived calibration may be reused after prediction/endpoint equivalence or conservativeness is established
change_control.primary_tolerance: keep 1/10 for the declared primary result; changes are labeled as new requirements
change_control.development_changes: record revisions; finish development before final calibration

required_first_demo_outputs: complete source and executable regeneration command
calibration inputs, targets, predictions and loss arithmetic
machine-readable certificate and readable comparison report
reference-risk audit with all outcomes retained

completion_definition.scientific_contract: scientific contract and implementation requirements documented; empirical performance claims require a completed calibration assessment
completion_definition.engineering_success: complete reproducible valid assessment of all three candidates
completion_definition.acceptance_success: at least one KAHM candidate may be reported as meeting the requirement only when its valid U is <=1/10
completion_definition.execution_order: generate development data, fit encoders and readouts, freeze the model family and protocol, assess calibration losses, then audit population risks

sources.role: exact history-successor law and analytical reference risks
training-only geometry, Gaussian KAHM reconstruction, partition memberships, and local coordinates
matched Gaussian Nystrom and linear features, ridge objective, and fixed validation selection
bounded iid fitted-risk upper bounds and simultaneous confidence allocation
exact loss arithmetic, verified logarithms, outer root endpoints, and direct endpoint checks

development_configuration_requirements: reference partitions, numbers of local models and reference budget
PCA caps, effective-rank handling and reconstruction regularization
deterministic numerical thresholds and exceptional-input behavior
decoder standardization, landmark budget and selection details
Gaussian bandwidth grid and ridge penalty grid
RNG implementation, concrete seeds, runtime and canonical inference convention
verified logarithm/root arithmetic and implementation tolerance
